verdict.rationale: WorkOS offers building blocks relevant to scoped agent credentials — M2M application credentials for programmatic API access (workos-docs-32), RBAC with custom roles/permissions enforced via session JWTs (workos-docs-3, workos-supp-rbac-jwt), and an OAuth-based AuthKit authorization server specifically for MCP agent access (workos-docs-27, workos-docs-9, workos-probe-4). However, the MCP docs state a connected agent 'can read and change the same dashboard data you can,' suggesting broad rather than least-privilege scoping, and there is no explicit documentation of fine-grained scope definitions or least-privilege token issuance tailored to agents. Missing for 10: documented granular OAuth scopes/permission tiers for agent credentials, explicit least-privilege enforcement examples, and independent verification of scoped-down agent access in practice.
